notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). The skill gives an overview of setting up SAST with Semgrep, SonarQube and CodeQL: quick-start commands, a GitHub Actions step, a pre-commit hook, best practices, a sample custom Semgrep rule, a PCI-focused scan, troubleshooting and a tool comparison.

Medium: the Basic Setup (SKILL.md:57-67) has the agent `pip install semgrep`, run `semgrep --config=auto` (which downloads rules from the Semgrep registry), start a SonarQube container from a pinned image (sonarqube:10.8-community), and `gh extension install github/gh-codeql`. Acceptable because these are the tools' standard, read-only scanning setups run on the user's own code at their request; nothing touches credentials beyond the user's existing gh login, and no destructive commands appear.

Broken references, not required for the skill to work: `./scripts/run-sast.sh` (SKILL.md:127) and `references/semgrep-rules.md` (SKILL.md:133) are not in the skill directory; the Basic Setup section already provides working commands, so the agent should use those. Related Skills (SKILL.md:173-174) link to sibling skills ../stride-analysis-patterns/ and ../threat-mitigation-mapping/ as optional reading only.
